Data Scientist (Forecasting)

What you will do
Build forecasting and experimentation tools used by operations teams. Write
clear system prompts and evaluation sets for our internal assistant, and
explain model results to non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications
- Degree in statistics, computer science, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience with Python, SQL, and time-series models.
- Ability to follow written instructions and document assumptions.

Preferred
- Experience with Airflow and experiment platforms.
